Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging.replication

Interface PublicationReceiverFacade

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    InPlacePublicationReceiverFacade
    public interface PublicationReceiverFacade
    Business-Interface through which the replication algorithm can interface with the publisher server for replicating content. This can be implemented locally in the server, but could also be routed remotely to a publisher host.

    • Method Detail

      • startUpdate

        @NotNull
@NotNull PublicationReceiverFacade.StatusWithReleaseData startUpdate​(@NotNull
                                                                     @NotNull ReplicationPaths replicationPaths)
                                                              throws ReplicationException
        Starts an update process on the remote side. To clean up resources, either #commitUpdate(UpdateInfo, String, Set, Stream, ExceptionThrowingRunnable) or abortUpdate(UpdateInfo) must be called afterwards.
        Parameters:
        replicationPaths - information about the release root, source and target paths during replication. The ReplicationPaths.getContentPath() can contain the root content path that should be considered, if it is only a subpath of the ReplicationPaths.getOrigin().
        Returns:
        the basic information about the update which must be used for all related calls on this update.
        Throws:
        ReplicationException

      • compareParents

        com.composum.sling.core.servlet.Status compareParents​(@NotNull
                                                      @NotNull ReplicationPaths replicationPaths,
                                                      @NotNull
                                                      @NotNull org.apache.sling.api.resource.ResourceResolver resolver,

                                                      @NotNull Supplier<Stream<ChildrenOrderInfo>> relevantOrderings,

                                               throws ReplicationException
        Compares children order and attributes of the parents. Returns in .data(PARAM_CHILDORDERINGS).get(PARAM_PATH) a list of paths that have different children ordering and in .data(PARAM_ATTRIBUTEINFOS).get(PARAM_PATH) a list of paths that have different attributes.
        Throws:
        ReplicationException
